fusions.name: Cull the Strong
fusions.desc: Brings a commanded blow down on the target, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heel Bark
fusions.desc: Barks an order that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Muster the Pack
fusions.desc: Every ally within 6 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Eye for the Weak
fusions.desc: You deal 15% more damage to enemies at low health.
